dhrystone.scope: ROI: existing setStats boundaries around 500 Dhrystone iterations and timer reads; wall: simulator process including final drain

towers.scope: ROI: existing setStats boundaries around towers_solve, 7 discs, after preallocation; wall: simulator process including final drain

mm.scope: ROI: all 8 existing mm kernel repetitions, including per-iteration timer reads, excluding printing/verification; wall: simulator process including final drain

rsort.scope: ROI: existing setStats boundaries around sort, 2048 elements, after preallocation; wall: simulator process including final drain

mt-matmul.scope: ROI: matmul and barrier on one hart, 16x16 dataset, excluding printing/verification; wall: simulator process including final drain

memcpy.scope: ROI: existing setStats boundaries around 16000-byte memcpy, after preallocation; wall: simulator process including final drain

qsort.scope: ROI: existing setStats boundaries around sort, 2048 elements, after preallocation; wall: simulator process including final drain

validation.history_checks: First collection trace from every workload passed the independent branch/history checker; see history-validation.log

counter_definitions.target_cycles: mcycle delta while mcountinhibit is clear between staged setStats calls; region described per workload; includes boundary/call bookkeeping
counter_definitions.retired_instructions: minstret delta over the same inhibited ROI boundaries
counter_definitions.icache_acquires: mhpmcounter4, mhpmevent4=0x102: BOOM event set 2, event 0; I-cache acquire/refill transactions
counter_definitions.branch_misprediction_recoveries: mhpmcounter3, mhpmevent3=0x201: BOOM event set 1, event 1; io.branch_mispredict (b2.mispredict), not committed conditional-branch errors
counter_definitions.host_cycles_blocked: Run-wide emulated host clocks satisfying hPort.toHost.hValid && hPort.fromHost.hReady && initDone && capture && !captures.io.enq.ready; excludes host CPU time spent decoding/writing CSV
counter_definitions.capture_occupancy: Pending target-cycle batches in capture queue; excludes active serializer batch and downstream stream queue; final snapshot after drain and run-wide maximum
counter_definitions.wall_seconds: Python monotonic elapsed time around simulator subprocess, including startup and final trace drain/close; excludes build time

notes: Same previously built simulator with local AutoTrace overhead counters; scalar RV64GC staged workloads, no CTR sampler. Source revisions may have pre-existing local edits; staged source hashes and ELF/image hashes are recorded.
